findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Subscriptions.Rules.refundOnCancel matches no observation and cites no authority: 'match' branch (line 16); 'when' branch (line 17); comparison '= "SCALE"' (line 18); 'when' branch (line 18); comparison '>= 150' (line 18); 'when' branch (line 19); wildcard default returning 0m for unlisted cases (line 20). A wildcard default silently decides every unlisted case; no record authorizes that default. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
